# Visionary Nexus — Agent Execution Engine

## CORE IDEA
This layer defines how agents execute tasks inside the ecosystem runtime model.

It simulates real-time intelligence flow across the system.

---

## 1. EXECUTION MODEL

Task Input →
→ Router Layer
→ Agent Selection
→ Parallel Processing
→ Output Synthesis
→ System Feedback Loop

---

## 2. ROUTING LOGIC

The system determines:

- task complexity
- required agent types
- execution priority
- dependency chains

---

## 3. PARALLEL EXECUTION

Multiple agents can execute simultaneously:

- Analyzer Agent → interpretation
- Builder Agent → structure generation
- Automation Agent → workflow execution
- Security Agent → validation layer

---

## 4. OUTPUT SYNTHESIS

All agent outputs are combined into:

- final system response
- structured module update
- or automation trigger

---

## 5. FEEDBACK LOOP

Every execution result feeds back into:

- roadmap updates
- rule refinement
- agent optimization

---

## 6. SYSTEM BEHAVIOR RULE

The system does not execute linear steps.
It executes distributed intelligence flows.

---

## FINAL PRINCIPLE

Visionary Nexus operates as a simulated AI runtime ecosystem,
where agents behave like a coordinated intelligence network.
